The query retrieves the wingspan values for the two specified aircraft models. WHERE (toLower(m2.name) CONTAINS toLower('Anson') 
   OR ANY(alias IN m2.aliases WHERE toLower(alias) CONTAINS toLower('Anson'))) 
   AND m2 <> m1
RETURN abs(toFloat(m1.wingspan_metre) - toFloat(m2.wingspan_metre)) AS wingspan_difference"

}
